verdict: Built to remove ownership friction, not to win a finishing contest.

insights.label: Design + originality
insights.headline: The square is not retro styling. It is lineage.
insights.text: The GW-5000U preserves a design language G-Shock established in 1983. Its familiarity comes from authorship, not imitation.

insights.label: Movement + engineering
insights.headline: No mechanical movement. No problem.
insights.text: Tough Solar, Multi Band 6 and quartz accuracy create a highly efficient technical solution with very little routine intervention.

insights.label: Wearability + versatility
insights.headline: Big numbers. Light experience.
insights.text: The case is substantial on paper, but 74 g and a soft strap keep wearability strong. Its practical range is huge; its formal range is not.
